_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for every company fact used anywhere on the site. A number is defined once here and never diverges between pages. Every '[[TODO: ...]]' value must be replaced with a verified figure from internal sources before launch — an empty marker is correct, an invented number is a failure. '_comment' keys describe what to supply and in what unit; they are ignored by the templates. Values marked 'from brief' came from the project brief and should still be confirmed.

identity._comment: Legal and brand identity. Used in the footer, /legal, /about and the JSON-LD Organization schema. NOTE: the registered legal name is NOT the same as the trading name used in site copy — never guess it from the domain or trading name; take it exactly as recorded in the commercial register.

When permission is confirmed: set permissionToDisplay true and fill named[] with {name, image} — the pages switch to the named logo wall (Version A) automatically, no rebuild.

machinesStatus._comment: Status of the machine park data, kept OUTSIDE 'machines' so that overwriting 'machines' with a new machines.json export never loses it. 'machines' below is a verbatim drop-in: the same schema as the incoming file (areas keyed by slug, items with make/model/count/year/control/range/tolerance/capacity/note). null = not known yet and renders as an em dash — never invent a value.
machinesStatus.source: April 2026 company profile presentation (primary source). The old website is used only where the presentation is silent — the named wood machines, and the ±0.05 mm cutting tolerance. Laser model written LT5, not the presentation's 'BL5': BLM Group has no BL5. Makes the presentation does not name are left null rather than carried over from the old site, because the groupings no longer match — the machine plates settle them.
machinesStatus.nextStep: Tolerance is 1 of 44 rows. When the machine-plate photographs arrive, a new machines.json fills make, model, year and tolerance; replace the whole 'machines' object.
machinesStatus._confirm: OPEN — powder coating line: an EU-funded project (~BGN 930,000) for a new powder coating facility + welding robot was approved. Is the listed line the existing one (new one separate) or the upgraded one? Do not publish until clarified.
